method: Single-assistant complete source visual audit. Read all 10 rendered office pages row by row and recorded each printed serial, name, and category, then compared those readings with the parsed source-row snapshot. This is not human double entry or a blinded independent annotator study; the reviewer also developed the original parser and had prior sample familiarity.

comparison_rules.name: Collapse whitespace for comparison, retaining the visually recorded raw line breaks and spelling. No geographic-name normalization.
comparison_rules.category: Treat an empty parsed raw-category string as equivalent to a visibly blank source category; preserve semantic nulls.
comparison_rules.axis: Verify derived caste/women axes against each visually read printed code; these are semantic checks of the code, not additional printed fields.

scope_limits: Audit covers office synopsis pages 58–67 only; it does not verify the separate ward aggregates or other 142 handbook pages.
The blank Pradhan category at serial 123 is a source limitation, not a transcription ambiguity.
Blocks are not printed in these tables and remain unknown.
The source uses repeated GP names; serial-based source keys remain necessary.
Temporary renders are reproducible from the pinned source PDF; their hashes identify the exact images inspected.
